reason: The returns, UL listing and photo reviews are all reassuring, but I buy lighting from Wayfair, West Elm or Lumens because I know how a return or a damaged box gets handled. A paper cloud pendant from a one-person shop in Oklahoma is not something I would put in my cart this week.
objection: Sixty reviews on a store nobody has heard of, and I have no idea how it handles a cracked shade or a return that goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the same pendant on Wayfair, Amazon or Lumens with a few hundred reviews, or a designer I follow showing it installed in a real home.
